convert_seggpt_checkpoint: convert a SegGPT checkpoint from the original BAAI repository to HuggingFace transformers format
create_rename_keys: create a mapping of key names to convert original SegGPT checkpoint keys to HuggingFace naming convention
run_seggpt_conversion_cli: run the SegGPT checkpoint conversion CLI to dump a converted model to a local directory
verify_seggpt_logits: verify converted SegGPT model logits match the original implementation within tolerance
push_seggpt_to_hub: push a converted SegGPT model and image processor to the Hugging Face hub
